BillHeading.Sponsors: House Technology & Economic Development (originally sponsored by Representatives Lytton, Jinkins, Pollet, and Frame)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Eliminating certain tax preferences not being used and recommended for repeal as determined by the joint legislative audit and review committee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to eliminating certain tax preferences not being used and recommended for repeal as determined by the joint legislative audit and review committee; and repealing RCW 82.16.055.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 82.16.055 (Deductions relating to energy conservation or production from renewable resources) and 1980 c 149 s 3 are each repealed.
